snippet.title: For Her Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
For Her is a single-player, story-driven psychological horror game that delves into the depths of morality, sacrifice, and the human psyche. 

You play as David Hill, a dedicated police officer in Dismas City. A loving husband and father, David always puts his family first, no matter the cost.

You can play the demo now on Itch.io and Steam, links in comments!
